PreToolUse.bash: r="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -f "$r/hooks/py.sh" ] || { echo 'bossa guard: plugin root not found; guard skipped' >&2; exit 0; }; BOSSA_HOST=copilot "$r/hooks/py.sh" architect_guard.py
PreToolUse.powershell: if (-not (Test-Path "${PLUGIN_ROOT}\hooks\architect_guard.py")) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('bossa guard: plugin root not found; guard skipped'); exit 0 }; $env:BOSSA_HOST='copilot'; py -3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}\hooks\architect_guard.py"; exit $LASTEXITCODE
